description: Renew an existing Dragons Eye watchlist by watchlist_id. You need the Authorization: Bearer manage_token you got when it was created. POST /v1/watchlists/renew. $2.00 USDC on Base per call. Adds 30 days. Don't use this to create a new watchlist; use /v1/watchlists. [x402: pays from the caller's wallet (X402_PRIVATE_KEY); without a key the tool returns the live 402 price only.]
name: watchlist_watchlists_renew
title: Dragons Eye Watchlist: POST /v1/watchlists/renew
